title: The read-only command list omits `cut`, so a progress read such as `tail FILE | cut -c1-150` refuses a carried gate's credit
outcome: A line built only from pure readers, `cut` among them, is judged read-only by the Claude Bash read-only policy, so it neither refuses a carried gate's credit nor is denied to a read-only reviewer.
acceptance: The full gate passed on the exact landed input.

`cut` with its reading flags (`-c`, `-f`, `-d`, `-b`, `-s`, `--complement`) is accepted by claude_bash_tokens_are_read_only; a test covers `tail -2 FILE | cut -c1-150` as read-only and `cut` with an output redirection as not.
